## Verified -1 on change 3190 — true positive, fixed

CI run 41271076673 failed deterministically on all 4 pytest cells:

    tests/integration/test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py
      ::test_no_test_addresses_a_bare_repository_by_discovery

10 findings, all in `tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py`
(:280, :288, :296, :304, :312, :317, :331, :359, :380, :389):
"bare repository 'origin' addressed via git()".

### Why the merge exposed it (the violation is older than this change)

The violating lines are NOT new. They exist on `origin/main` today, in the
held-out twin `test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py` (:34, :42, :50, :58, :66,
:71, :85, :113, :134, :143), and main is green.

The scanner is per-module. On main the twin does:

    from test_run_reconcile_bridge import bridge_workspace, git

so `origin` arrives from an IMPORTED fixture and the AST pass cannot bind it to
a bare repository — no finding. `bridge_workspace` is what calls
`init_bare_remote(origin, ...)`. Merging the twins put the fixture and its call
sites in ONE module, so the detector resolves `origin` as bare and reports all
10.

`EXCLUDED_FILES` in the scan module is only the scan module itself, so this was
never a `*_heldout.py` exemption — it was an import boundary hiding real
violations from a per-module scanner. That is a latent-defect class this epic
exists to surface, and merging the twins is what surfaced it.

### The violation is real, not a scanner artifact

    $ git config --global safe.bareRepository explicit
    $ git -C <bare> rev-parse --is-bare-repository
    fatal: cannot use bare repository '...' (safe.bareRepository is 'explicit')
    $ git --git-dir <bare> rev-parse --is-bare-repository
    true

Any developer with `safe.bareRepository=explicit` would have hit exit 128 on
those 10 call sites.

### Fix

Routed exactly the bare-repository call sites through the existing `bare_git`
helper (`--git-dir`), leaving `git()` (`-C`) for the `seed` and `checkout`
worktrees. 10 replacements; `bare_git(origin,` now appears 13 times (10 new +
the 3 already in `_assert_delivered`). No new helper, no new mechanism — the
module already had `bare_git` at :52.

### Evidence

    pytest tests/integration/test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py
      -> 6 passed in 16.23s
    git config --global safe.bareRepository explicit
    pytest tests/scripts/test_run_reconcile_bridge.py -p no:randomly
      -> 31 passed in 114.70s

Amended as `db0fb9c44f9` (Change-Id preserved, so this uploads as a new patch
set on change 3190 rather than a duplicate change). `make verify` queued —
holding it until a slot frees, as 3 verifies are already running on this host
(load 42, 1.3 GB free).

### Process finding filed separately

`make verify` structurally could not have caught this: `make test` selects
`-m "not integration and not external"`, which deselects all 6 tests in that
policy module, while CI's gating cell runs them. Filed as bug
`gratuitous-mirthful-drafthorse` (a8af-ac33-74aa-4ccd), linked
`discovered_from` this story.
